method: independent second check; every stage of l1-l6 read in full; numeric answers recomputed by script; encyclopedia titles verified

corrections.what: question asked 'which has the longer history?' but the keyed answer was 'both have history'; reworded to 'Which statement is true?'
why said 'the two continents of the West' (a Eurocentric framing); replaced with a neutral explanation
why claimed early peoples lived on every continent, but the pairs cover four; reworded

order item put 'Asia and Europe' before Australia, but Australia (at least 50,000 years ago) is probably earlier than Europe (about 45,000); changed to Africa > Asia > Australia > The Americas and updated why
Hammurabi 'about 3,700 years ago' changed to about 3,800 (reign c.1792-1750 BCE)
said Confucius 'wrote rules'; his teachings were compiled by followers, so changed to 'taught'
'Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples ... at least 50,000 years' wrongly applied the date to Torres Strait Islanders; separated the two peoples
key option 'No such land existed' was misleading (Australia exists); reworded to 'No great, warm southern continent was there'
stem said 'A lord wants to raise taxes' but the event is Magna Carta and King John; changed to 'A king'
distractor 'Gunpowder weapons' arguably also reached Europe via the Islamic world or Mongols; replaced with 'Maize from the Americas'
chinampas described as 'floating-style'; they are raised plots, not floating; reworded
telescope described as a navigation tool; reworded to instruments and charts
removed the overly easy keywords 'church' and 'anger' from the third group so a vague answer cannot earn credit
distractor 'Asians were the first to discover them' is arguably defensible; replaced with 'Only European voyagers matter in this story'
keyed option was vague; now states the competing readings of 1857 (military mutiny versus wider popular uprising or war of independence)
stem 'ended French rule in Indochina's north' was imprecise; now 'effectively ended French colonial rule in Indochina'

corrections.at: l6 s5 sources; l6 s9 sources
corrections.what: Wikipedia title 'Silver trade' does not exist; replaced with 'Potosí'

needsSpecialist.what: Carthage presented as one of Africa's 'civilisations'; fine geographically, but a regional historian might prefer a note on its Phoenician origins
Heian/Kamakura start dates (1185) and the Sikh founding date (about 1500) are conventional; a South or East Asian specialist could confirm the preferred framing
da Gama's use of a local pilot at Malindi is widely stated, but the pilot's identity (and any link to Ahmad ibn Majid) is disputed; the item does not name him
Armenian genocide toll ('about a million or more'), Herero and Nama, and Srebrenica wording are standard but sensitive; a specialist in genocide studies should confirm the tone and figures
Gunditjmara/Budj Bim volcanic-memory claim and the Ice Age sea-level stories are presented as debated; an Indigenous studies specialist should confirm the framing
